selection.eligible: Previously scored current nominal sequences, including incoming nominal; not arbitrary population members
selection.objective: C + alpha * prefix_D; task-only C when alpha0
selection.ties: Earliest strictly improving nominal, matching prototype less-than update

score.definition: D=.5*sum_t sum_action (physical_U - bounded_pi(pre_action_state))**2; raw sum, no horizon normalization in weights
score.complete_trajectory: Exact requested full sum over T1000
score.fall_extension: Executable prefix including fall-causing action only; missing post-fall D terms are not fabricated; native terminal/tail C remain
score.alpha_justification: Fixed .12 equals historical weak w=.06 times sum(error²) in raw torque units. Maximum per-control D=12 gives omitted alpha*D<=1.44, below native absorbing charge5; no retuning or adaptation.
score.alpha_schedule: None; same nonzero .12 all coupled rounds/queries
score.independent_population_D: Not computed: NaN plus an explicit unavailable flag, never a fabricated zero. Current nominal D is measured separately for diagnostics.
score.nominal_D: Measure every current nominal in both arms; never use D in independent-arm weights.
score.reported_RMS: sqrt(2*D/executed_controls); coordinate MSE is 2*D/(6*executed_controls). Retained teacher paths have1000 controls.
score.fall_cost: Charge native terminal20 once, then5 per missing live control; never add terminal cost twice.

admission.walking: Full1000-control survival and mean absolute speed error<=.3 around target1.5 m/s.
admission.initial_cost: Native replayed complete cost of same bound source path from exact initial context
admission.if_rejected: Preserve raw best proposal/failure and retain prior incumbent

queries.initialization: Frozen original slot0 controls from beginning for every query; never current bank or equal-clock suffix
queries.policy: Current post-fit policy at rounds1..20; bound parent at round0
queries.optimizer_rule: Same FullPI update, geometrical noise scale1 to.1 across25 refinements and ESS target.05; no horizon shifting or physical execution inside a solve.
queries.nominal_states_and_statistics: Preserve all query nominal states, controls, RNG and per-candidate C/Dpartial/J/weights/first-fall counts
queries.qualification: Selected query trajectory fully survives1000 controls and has velocity MAE<=.3; report query cost, walking and survival for every paid query.
queries.missing: Anchor unavailable after student termination stays missing, no dummy query or zero discrepancy
queries.gap: L2 norm of first teacher-query action minus saved actor action at exact pre-action context
queries.anchor0: Reset-state action disagreement, plus true paired full1000 policy-query cost gap
queries.anchor100: Post-deviation action disagreement and query own outcomes only; cost not paired to900-control actor suffix
queries.strong_gap_claim: Both anchors must be available and query-walking-qualified for both arms throughout early rounds1..5 and late rounds16..20; otherwise this stream student-gap criterion is UNRESOLVED.

evaluation.frozen_parent_baseline: At round0 evaluate the parent once per stream and share both arms. Reevaluate the unchanged parent once per stream on every round1..20 panel and the confirmation panel for paired parent-child gains.
evaluation.training_exclusion: All reset panels/query states/parent-baseline traces excluded from fitting and admission decisions
evaluation.walking_rule: Survive1000 controls with velocity MAE<=.3. Survival without walking is retention only.
evaluation.joint_angles: Save actual six joint angles in every selected-teacher and policy trace; preserve missing post-fall samples and show all cases.

seeds.fit_argument_rule: Passed but ignored while continuing the bound inherited Adam/private-PCG state; never reseed it

teacher_gap.phase: Post-fit reconstruction on retained teacher trajectories
teacher_gap.aggregation: Equal-trajectory mean of each trajectory RMS L2 action residual

student_gap.aggregation: Perstream,peranchor means overfixed early/late round windows
student_gap.qualification: Every fixed anchor is available and query-walking-qualified in both arms throughout both windows; no improvement by censoring or subset selection.

criteria.undefined_denominators: A gap denominator<=1e-12 makes its percentage criterion UNRESOLVED; no artificial epsilon pass.
criteria.retention_interpretation: Report survival and controls descriptively; longer survival without walking is retention improvement, never competent walking.

stopping: Execute exactly20 alternating rounds and fixed100/25 refinement budgets. Do not stop for one unsuccessful fit, poor walking result or flat curve. Stop on source, input, context, shape, numerical, continuation, evidence, resource or budget failure and preserve paid work. No replacement seeds, retries, parent refits, new teachers, adaptive alpha, other interventions or automatic follow-ups. Settling is a diagnostic and authorizes no extra iterations.
claim_scope: Finite fixed-score versus alpha0 alternating contrast with two fixed source paths and three paired parent streams. I25 teacher queries approximate a lower-budget study operator; direct policy pull can mechanically reduce their gap. Walking, teacher competence and query qualification remain necessary. Frozen parent baselines are not compute-matched plain cloning. No broad CIO reproduction or project-success claim.
